drop_window.tooltip: A floating window you can drag files into, and out of into any app

empty.title: Nothing on the shelf
empty.body: Open the drop window and drag files onto it. They wait here until you drag them out again.

paste.label: Paste
paste.tooltip: Add copied files, or file paths, from the clipboard

copy_all.label: Copy all
copy_all.tooltip: Copy every file, ready to paste in a file manager

clear.label: Clear
clear.tooltip: Remove everything from the shelf. Files on disk are not touched.

flash.paste_empty: No files or paths on the clipboard
flash.nothing_to_copy: Nothing to copy: the files are missing

shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.summary: {keys} opens and closes the drop window.
shortcut.invalid: The shortcut setting is not a key combination like Super+Shift+D. Change it in Settings → Plugins → Shelf.
shortcut.confirm: This adds the line to {path}. A backup is saved next to it as .shelf-backup.
shortcut.desktop: Open System Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts and add a custom shortcut for {keys} that runs:
shortcut.unknown: Bind {keys} in your compositor's config to this command:

notify.no_data_dir: Shelf cannot find its data folder
notify.launch_failed: Shelf could not start the drop window

missing_deps.title: Shelf needs GTK 4 for Python
missing_deps.body: Install python3-gobject and gtk4 (python-gobject on Arch), or point the Python setting at an interpreter that has them.

window_position.label: Drop window position
window_position.description: Where the drop window opens. Drag its header to move it. Needs gtk4-layer-shell; without it the compositor places the window.
window_position.last: Where you last moved it (at the cursor until then)

remove_after_drag.label: Remove after dragging out
remove_after_drag.description: Take files off the shelf once they are dropped into another app.

close_after_drag.label: Close window after dragging out
close_after_drag.description: Hide the drop window once files are dropped into another app.

python.label: Python interpreter
python.description: Leave empty to use /usr/bin/python3. Set it when your GTK 4 bindings live in another interpreter.

show_count.label: Show count
show_count.description: Show how many files are on the shelf next to the icon.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the widget while the shelf is empty.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Keys that open and close the drop window, like Super+Shift+D. Wayland compositors own the keyboard, so open the Shelf panel and use the keyboard button to add the shortcut to your compositor.
